name: `shoptet validate` command
description:
Run the same lint + typecheck checks CI will run, locally, against the project's pinned generation/template. Implement the severity policy from §8: deterministic findings (TS typecheck, schema/manifest violations, datalayer fields absent from schema) are errors with a non-zero exit code; findings that depend on platform data that moves under the partner (not present yet in the MVP, but the contract must exist) are warnings with exit code zero.

Support --strict (promote warnings to errors) and --max-warnings N. Uses the shared Diagnostic contract: { code, severity, file, range, message, docUrl, fixable? }.

Reference: cli-greenfield.md §8, §9.
